experiment: A7 real governance ablation via Fabric's own transaction endorsement policy
real_policy_v2.11: default channel policy = MAJORITY Endorsement (both orgs, per configtx.yaml)
ablated_policy_v2.12: explicit --signature-policy "OR('Org1MSP.member')" at chaincode commit (only Org1 needed)

cases.name: real_single_org_submission
cases.submission: endorsed by Org1 peer only (Org2 omitted)
cases.final_ledger_state: record does not exist -- correctly rejected

cases.name: ablated_single_org_submission
cases.submission: endorsed by Org1 peer only (Org2 omitted)
cases.final_ledger_state: record EXISTS, genuinely committed: amount=200000, class=SAFE -- accepted with only 1 org's endorsement

cases.name: restoration_verification_single_org
cases.submission: endorsed by Org1 peer only (Org2 omitted)
cases.final_ledger_state: record does not exist -- correctly rejected again, governance restored

cases.name: restoration_verification_normal_dual_org
cases.submission: endorsed by both Org1 and Org2 peers (normal operation)
cases.final_ledger_state: record exists, SAFE -- confirms normal operation unaffected by restoration
